summary: Completed frontend testing for product card and PDP mobile layout changes. All major features working correctly.

DESKTOP shop cards: vertical layout (image top, content below), NO category label, NO description text
Format pills on cards: stacked layout with format name on top and price below
Quantity selector present on ALL product cards (shop, home, carousels)
Quantity increment/decrement works correctly, never goes below 1
Add to cart adds selected format with chosen quantity
Quantity resets to 1 after adding to cart
Clicking +/- buttons does NOT navigate to product page
Home page mobile: featured/recommended cards use same horizontal layout with quantity selector
Wishlist heart button toggles without navigation
PDP 'Explora más categorías' collapsible works (closed by default, opens on click)
Mobile bottom nav present and functional (menu opens drawer, cart button present with badge)
